references.text: business_logic: '- Read calendar dates from utils.marketo__calendar_spine (use date_day as provided). - Read leads from intermediate.int_marketo__lead (use lead_id and created_timestamp only). - Join rows where the calendar date is on or after the lead''s created date (using the date portion of created_timestamp). - If created_timestamp is null, the lead contributes no rows. - The upper bound of dates is defined only by the calendar spine; no additional end-date filter is applied. - No de-duplication is performed; duplicates from either source are preserved. - Create lead_day_id by converting date_day and lead_id to text, replacing nulls with empty strings, concatenating them with an underscore, then hashing the result with MD5. - Output columns: date_day, lead_id, lead_day_id; no explicit ordering.'
